title: LINK resident spin-flip TDA optimization
summary: Optimize a resident MATRIX-GFN2 spin-flip TDA state with analytic frozen-orbital and matrix-free Z-vector gradients and strict APOC character following.
gates: analytic frozen-orbital plus matrix-free Z-vector gradient
APOC transition-density assignment at every accepted geometry
root expansion on ambiguous or discontinuous assignments
gradient recomputation when electronic character changes root index
SYCART or SONIC symmetry-adapted nonredundant coordinates
coordinate_policy: LINK consumes a certified symmetry-adapted nonredundant SYCART or SONIC chart; electronic-state identity never changes the coordinate contract.
backend_policy: Only resident MATRIX-GFN2 SF-TDA supplies energies and analytic gradients; APOC owns state identity and LINK owns steps, rejection and root-gradient consistency.
